newsitem.title: UK: Y. Water says faces 140 mln stg windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: Y. Water says faces 140 mln stg windfall tax.

text.p: Britain's Yorkshire Water said on Thursday it expected to pay about 140 million stg in windfall tax, a new one-off tax imposed by the recent Labour government budget on privatised utility companies.
Yorkshire Water's chairman Brandon Gough told the annual meeting of shareholders that the tax would be paid out of additional borrowings and would have no impact on prices to customers before 2000.
Chancellor Gordon Brown' intention is to raise about 5.2 billion stg out of the windfall tax to finance various social welfare schemes.
Privatised water companies are expected to contribute about 1.65 billion stg towards this tax.
